thread:
dana: Heads-up: HorizonRx submitted a billing dispute for a $14,360 dedicated overage on their June invoice. They claim a scheduled maintenance triggered failover and autoscale, and want the charge reversed. @priya @josh can you look?

priya: Please drop the invoice excerpt and the exact window. I'll pull meter lines and check tags.

josh: Also need the incident ID from ops. @ops-bot can you paste?

ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-512: scheduled-maintenance -> region-failover-ap-south -> us-east-2. start: 2026-06-22T23:50Z end: 2026-06-23T02:10Z. Affected pools: horizonrx-dedicated-prod-a,b.

dana: Customer paste: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-0629
Reserved commit: $10,000
Burst/overage: $14,360
Period: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30
Claimed impact window: 2026-06-22 23:50 - 2026-06-23 02:10 UTC (failover)
```

josh: Pulling usage: compute burst ~$9,100; cross-region egress ~$2,300; transient storage/rehydration ~$670; misc tags/rounding ~$290 => total ~$12,360 in our meter. There's a $2,000 delta. Could be a billing window or customer-side tag mismatch.

priya: If our meter shows less than invoice they uploaded, ask them for the PDF page with line items. But we should still consider a goodwill offer if their demo was impacted.

rachel: Contract: reserved SLA 99.9%. For maintenance we give notice; credits discretionary. Legal flagged we should avoid establishing entitlement for future planned maints.

josh: Proposed options: 1) Full waive (bad precedent). 2) Partial goodwill: waive all egress + 50% compute burst. 3) Small fixed credit + free month of Dedicated Insights. I'm leaning to option 2.

priya: Estimate for option 2 using our meter: waive egress $2,300 + compute credit 50% of $9,100 = $4,550 -> total $6,850. Mark as "Goodwill - maintenance linked".

legal-bot: Legal quick note: discretionary credits OK. Recommend adding a one-line clause in the customer note: "This credit is goodwill and does not imply changes to billing policies."

rachel: Approving the partial goodwill credit + retention add-on. Keep the wording tight, no admission of fault.

josh: Creating credit memo CM-2026-1560: compute credit $4,550; egress waived $2,300; total credit $6,850. Tagging CM-2026-1560 as "Goodwill - ops incident".

billing-bot: CM-2026-1560 created and pending approval.

priya: I will reconcile the $2k invoice/meter delta after we issue the credit. Likely customer exported a slightly different window or included other services.

dana: I'll draft the customer reply: empathize, confirm credit applied, include postmortem summary link (customer-safe), and next steps.

josh: Applied CM-2026-1560 to INV-2026-0629. Journal entry JE-2026-1204 posted. Updated invoice sent to billing portal.

dana: Customer replied: "Thank you. Appreciated the fast response — the credit helps." Closing loop.

ops-bot: ACTIONS: 1) Credit applied - josh. 2) Customer comms - dana. 3) Postmortem summary - ops. 4) Follow-up tag reconciliation - priya.

rachel: Flag for product: consider adding opt-in reduced-autoscale-for-failover config for Dedicated pools to limit cost spikes. Created feature request FR-2026-44.

priya: Noted. I'll own the tagging reconciliation and close once done.
